claimed: Dockerfile builds the image and runs `python -m token_lab.cli`
actual: assumes `uv sync` installs token_lab as a package, but the `uv init` pyproject has no [build-system], so the project is never installed and `-m token_lab.cli` can't import; needed ENV PYTHONPATH=/app/src (plus COPY README.md)
lesson: generated Dockerfiles bake in assumptions about packaging; check whether the project is actually installed (build-system / uv package mode) before trusting a `-m pkg` entrypoint
